description: ProjectMan status block at session start (projectman session-context)

hooks.command: command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ProjectMan: the projectman plugin needs uv on PATH (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/); its MCP tools are unavailable until uv is installed.'; exit 0; }; exec uv run --quiet --project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" --extra all projectman session-context
